title: Answer: living systems maintain themselves out of equilibrium, and what counts as one is left open

statements.text: Predictive processing, in Seth's account, gives no definition of life and leaves open what counts as a living system. It reads living systems through autopoiesis and the free energy principle: they regenerate their own material basis, keep their boundaries, and exist in a state of low entropy, out of thermodynamic equilibrium with their environment. There are many more ways of being mush than of being alive. Which living systems are conscious, and whether life must be carbon based, are set aside as questions for another time.
